title.narrative: SCO Fight For Right: "LIDERKA Teen HUB: Empowering girls with disabilities in Ukraine"
SCO Fight For Right: "LIDERKA Teen HUB: Empowering girls with disabilities in Ukraine"

description.narrative: Fight For Right NGO, within a two-year project 2023-2025 y. will empower 30+ 12-14 y.o. girls with disabilities to become more independent and conscious about their rights, equip them with tools and knowledge necessary to take the lead of their own life both in the schools, family, among friends via online-trainings, LIDERKA School, Summer Camp and mentorship. Their caregivers will be introduced to the concepts of independent living and supported decision-making and inclusive education in order to apply them in a daily life of a teen. More than 100 teachers will participate in the training on inclusive education. Cooperation with the education system will serve for changing teachers’ perception of pupils with disabilities.
